issue.title: doctor model-macro scan exits on nested enum placeholders instead of returning JSON
issue.description: Confirmed 2026-10-20 during the cross-machine log audit. _model_preset_tokens expands raw parameterized macro content with process_macro_references(content), whose default error path prints and sys.exit(1). The local and registry handlers catch Exception, so SystemExit escapes. The research_swarm template legitimately contains #research/audio(edition={{ audio_edition }}); a static scan must not treat its unbound placeholder as a concrete invalid enum value. Use raise_on_error=True, keep diagnostics JSON-clean, and distinguish parameterized non-presets from invalid concrete presets. Add tests for nested enum placeholders, genuinely invalid concrete model routes, and completion of later checks. Source is unchanged between workspace 1592f4dbc and installed 2648c7cdd. Bounded medium scope with the exact failing call identified.

task_type_fields.impact: The default diagnostics bundle is unusable on both production hosts; subsequent checks never run.
task_type_fields.repro: On athena and apollo at sase 2648c7cdd, run sase doctor -C config.model_macros -j (apollo in zsh -lic). Exit 1 prints research/audio edition expects brief | full, got {{ audio_edition }}, with no JSON. Bare sase doctor -j has the same failure.

issue.creation_reason: A cross-machine production log audit found independently reproducible failures that need durable follow-up.
